title: Aaja Fazal Da Baba Besheer Di Ma Kurlavay
body:
Hun Alma Valeya Der Na La
Mera Asghar Na Mar Javay
<<DIVIDER>>
Hin Chotay Baal Tarapday
Maavan De Sheer Vi Khushak Howay
Koi Neher Kinaray O Ghazi Nu
Aina Paighaam Ponchavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Mata Sain Di Chaadar Lathjay
Lutt Behn Ton Pehlaan Aa Veera
Sajjad Beemar Behosh Peya
Ainu Keyra Hosh Karavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani Di Boond Nu Tarsan
Hai Malik Hozay Kausar Day
Aj Sain Rubab Di Jholi Nu
Ujran Ton Kaun Bachavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi Teray Bajon Jurtaan
Enjh Wadh Gaiyan Nay Shimar Diyan
Kadi Parday Lut Da Ay Bibiyan De
Kadee Khaimayan Nu Ag Lavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Toon Rakha Sain Zainab Da
Par Veer Da Akha Moreya Naee
Hun Aap Dasa Kinj Rasiyan Nu
Teri Sain Hathaan Vich Paavay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi Dee Sang Nu Tak Ke
Akhtar Ro Zainab Kayndee Si
Kinj Shimar Layeen Sakina Nu
Paya Ghoreyan Naal Doravay
